description: The army-select dropdowns only list the bundled armies on data/army_allowlist.json. No fixture: runs on the boot MainMenu. Asserts the allowlist loaded, every Player 1/Player 2/Plan Editor dropdown entry is an allowlisted (or user-imported) army, none of the test lists (A_C_test, *_codex_test, custodes_web_built_repro) or tutorial_* lists appear, yet those hidden lists are still on disk and loadable by id (get_available_armies). Real-clicks the Player 1 dropdown to open its popup and screenshots the cleaned-up list, then proves the ArmyListManager.show_all_armies dev override brings the hidden lists back.

steps.comment: every dropdown option is selectable; no hidden list leaked in
every allowlisted bundled army is offered
fresh user:// shows the first-run tutorial prompt over the menu; press its 'Not now' if present
dev override shows the hidden test lists again, then restore
steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
var before = m.army_options.size()
ArmyListManager.show_all_armies = true
m._load_available_armies()
m._populate_army_dropdowns()
var ids = []
for o in m.army_options:
	ids.append(str(o.id))
var ok = m.army_options.size() > before and ids.has("A_C_test") and not ids.has("tutorial_orks")
ArmyListManager.show_all_armies = false
m._load_available_armies()
m._populate_army_dropdowns()
m._set_default_army_selections()
return ok and m.army_options.size() == before
